text: This does what it says on the tin, and replicates a paper bullet journal. Most apps that call themselves bullet journals require you to add a due date to tasks, but this one allows you to add tasks to a particular day to create a daily to do list, just like in a paper journal. Some very useful features are: the widget, as I can have my to do list on the home screen of my phone; tagging of notes to group them; collections of tasks, which I use to create weekly to do lists; the link with google calendar so I can see my diary alongside my to do list. Some aspects of the app are a little clunky but the developer is constantly updating it and is very responsive to feedback. I would give it five stars if the data lived in the cloud so it could be used across devices, but at present it is local to a single device, which is inconvenient if that device runs out of battery.
